items.question: What bodily treatment makes the body incomparable?
premises: Goat urine buttermilk ground rub body.
items.inference: Applying goat urine, buttermilk, and ground paste to the body yields an incomparable body.
uncertainties: Exact ritual context and preparation remain unspecified.
items.plain_english: A body rubbed with goat urine, buttermilk, and ground paste becomes incomparable.
